events.summary: Speaker B stated the remote must be original, trendy and user friendly.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: you of course want it to be original

events.summary: Speaker B set the process as three phases: functional design, conceptual design, then detailed design.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: we first uh go through a functional design phase

events.summary: Speaker B said the selling price will be about twenty-five euros.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: the selling price of the product uh will be about twenty five Euros

events.summary: Speaker B stated the profit aim is about fifty million euros.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: profit aim, about fifty million Euro

events.summary: Speaker B said the international market will be mainly Europe and Northern America, with some Asian countries.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: it will be I think mainly Europe and uh Northern America

events.summary: Speaker B stated the production cost must be at most twelve euros fifty cents per remote.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: the product production cost must be maximal uh twelve uh twelve Euro and fifty cents

events.summary: Speaker C said the group has to sell at least four million remotes to make a profit.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: They have to sell at least four million to make a profit

events.summary: Speaker C said the remote should have an on-off button.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: it should have a on off button

events.summary: Speaker B said the application is television, so the remote controls the TV.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: We wer we were thinking television

events.summary: Speaker C said users need to browse the channels in an upward and downward way.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: You need to browse the browse the channels in upward downward way

events.summary: Speaker C said users need to record the channels.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: you need to record the channels

events.summary: Speaker B proposed channel up and down buttons, instead of retyping the number, especially with many channels.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: that you can go channel up or down ins instead of retyping the number

events.summary: Speaker C said the usual functions are needed: changing the volume and changing the channel, plus teletext.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: you'd need the usual ones, like the changing the volume, changing the the channel

events.summary: Speaker C proposed planning for newer TV functions such as internet and personal video recorders, which are coming up.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: For example personal video recorder and all those stuffs are coming up

events.summary: Speaker A objected that the team cannot design for functions that have not been invented yet.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we can't really design for something that hasn't been invented yet

events.summary: Speaker D proposed establishing the user requirements before designing the functions.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: we need to know what are the user requirements

events.summary: Speaker A said ninety to ninety-nine percent of the time people use the main functions.
events.speaker: A
events.value: 90 to 99 percent of use on main functions
events.quote: Ninety percent of the time, ninety nine percent of the time, people will be using the main functions

events.summary: Speaker A proposed the main controls be very obvious and very easy to use, with fancy extras secondary.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the main controls need to be very obvious and very easy to use

events.summary: Speaker B said the very fancy features can be left out, because the unit is a twenty-five euro remote.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: the very fancy stuff uh w we can leave that out, I think

events.summary: Speaker C proposed partnering with a company that already provides the features, and selling both products together.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: you can you always hook up with uh someone who is providing that

events.summary: Speaker A proposed getting TV manufacturers to supply the remote.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: So try and get T_V_ manufacturers to

events.summary: Speaker D objected that the group wants to design a new remote, not partner with an existing product.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: but w w we want to design a new one

events.summary: Speaker C summarised the needs as number buttons and teletext functions.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: So we need some numbering buttons, some teletext things

events.summary: Speaker B deferred the specification of which buttons will be on the remote to the next meeting.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: I think we can discuss that in the in the next meeting

events.summary: Speaker B assigned Speaker C to work on the technical function design for the next meeting, keeping it general.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: you will be working on on technical function design

events.summary: Speaker B asked Speaker A, the marketing role, to think about requirements, including whether the remote needs internet.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: think about requirements, eh? Does it need internet
